case_title: MOHD MUSLIM @ HUSSAIN v. STATE (NCT OF DELHI)
confession: Confessional statement of the appellant relied on
neutral_facts: The accused was arrested following a raid where 180 kilograms of ganja were recovered from four co-accused. The prosecution relied on the statement of one of the co-accused, the confessional statement of the accused, and bank statements of another co-accused indicating money transfers to the accused. The accused was not found in possession of the narcotic drug, and no other evidence was recovered from him. Two co-accused were granted bail, and the trial progressed slowly with 30 witnesses examined and 34 remaining. The accused was in custody for over 7 years and 4 months, leading to a bail application based on undue delay in the trial.
